records.text: Gladiator skill points: Rending Blow, Overhead Slam, Ruinous Blow and Attack Preparation to 10, then {skillOrderTwoSource} (the two flat passives to 10, the others to 8) (Metabot, daevaguides, mmo-codex, aion2turkiye). Rending Blow first, Ruinous Blow from Lv 14 and the two flat passives the level they are learned are two-source; the order between those rules is inferred.
First Daevanion nodes: Overhead Slam, Rending Blow and Ruinous Blow on Nezekan and Zikel (daevaguides, aion2turkiye); Metabot starts on the Attack Preparation and Survival Stance pairs instead.
Gladiator learn levels (Mocking Blade 3, Rush Strike 10, Ruinous Blow 14 and the rest): Metabot's skill pages (game data).

Overhead Slam's Lv 8 pick: Upward Strike chain (daevaguides, skycoach, mmo-codex's class page) over AoE (aion2turkiye's leveling panel) or HP absorb (aLuckyRO's mmo-codex guide); the guide takes Upward Strike chain.
Ruinous Blow's Lv 8 pick: +20% Skill Speed (daevaguides, skycoach) over +30% Skill Critical Hit (aion2turkiye and two creators) or +12.5 m range; the guide takes Skill Speed.
Keen Strike to 10 (Metabot and daevaguides; mmo-codex and aion2turkiye say 8) and Leaping Slam to 8 (daevaguides, mmo-codex; Metabot and aion2turkiye say 10): the guide takes 10 and 8.
Specialty picks: Rending Blow mobile, Keen Strike +20% MP at skill Lv 8; Rending Blow, Overhead Slam and Keen Strike's Lv 12 picks (daevaguides, mmo-codex, aion2turkiye, skycoach).
Stat priority (Attack, Critical Hit, Accuracy Bonus): Metabot's Gladiator page and class-builds guide (one site).

Stigmas Lunge Stance, Zikel's Blessing, Lifestealing Blade, Rage Burst (Metabot, aion2turkiye and daevaguides take these four); every source orders them differently, so the slot order is the guide's pick (Lunge Stance first has four sources). Raised to 8 / 6 / 5 / 5; Rage Burst 5 for its cooldown perk is two-source.
Stigma slots 22 / 27 / 32 / 37; every stigma learnable at 22; shard cost per level (Metabot, allthings.how).
